    The critical node without a support condition #

    The Kronecker pair of the critical node need not be supported at every vertex of its convex piece: covering data are obtained after restricting the pair to its support (PairCoveringData.ofPair). CriticalNode' and DichotomyNode' drop the support condition, and Theorem A with both corollaries follows from CriticalNode' and SSCNode (theoremA_of_critical'_ssc). CriticalNode implies CriticalNode'.

    The final proof does not use SSCNode; see MainTheorems.lean.
